name: Desert Flannel
bio: Archetype: Beast Synergy, DMG Buff, Counter. ⌽ Gains DMG Bonus with S2 riposte. ⌽ Ultimate grants team DMG Bonus to Beast allies. ⌽ Gains Moxie for every Beast teammate on stage entry for quick access to Ult. ⌽ Benefits the most from a mono-Beast team. ⌽ Lacks utility outside of Ult, healing locked to her Ult.
